title: Algebra 2: Polynomial Functions
tagline: Read end behavior, hunt zeros with multiplicity, divide and factor higher-degree polynomials, and sketch the whole curve.

chapters.title: Shape & End Behavior
chapters.description: Meet polynomial functions as graphs: evaluation, the four end-behavior patterns, and why the leading term rules them all.

chapters.title: Zeros & Factors
chapters.description: Read zeros straight from factored form, decode multiplicity as bounce-or-cross, and find factors with one substitution.

chapters.title: Polynomial Division
chapters.description: Long division, the three-row synthetic shortcut, and the divide-and-conquer loop that cracks cubics.

chapters.title: Factoring Higher Degree
chapters.description: GCF-first discipline, quadratic form, factoring by grouping, and the sum and difference of cubes.

chapters.title: Graphs & Models
chapters.description: Synthesize ends, zeros, and multiplicity into full sketches, bound degree by turning points, and build polynomials to order.
